description: Database migration script for changing specific MySQL columns from TEXT to MEDIUMTEXT and vice versa, using Alembic for schema migrations in the Superset project.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs schema migration to alter specified columns from TEXT to MEDIUMTEXT in MySQL dialect.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Reverts schema changes, altering columns back from MEDIUMTEXT to TEXT in MySQL dialect.
